data.guideTextData: The encoded messages revealed “Giyala falls by his betrayal”, but a commotion about another magic attack quickly draws attention...

storedDialogues: LIEZEL Is that so? I will have to look around or acquire it myself.
ANTIQUARIAN My notes... check... Hehehehe... Where could my next find be waiting for me?
SANTI (Uhh... Maybe I should leave him alone.)
SANTI There really are traces of oil here. This should work.
ANTIQUARIAN Hehehe, back already? What a shame you couldn’t find the oil-
SANTI I managed to find a source of oil!
ANTIQUARIAN O-Oh! Is that... so?
SANTI Yeah, what else do we need for the mixture?
ANTIQUARIAN ... Well, you’ll need three more natural materials: orchid sap, hibiscus sap, and hibiscus petals. Unfortunately, hibiscus flowers are hard to find these days.
SANTI (I think there are orchids around here in the forest, but as for the hibiscus...)
SANTI (If Liezel can find them, she may be able to mix them in from all the way back in the past.)
SANTI Let me just... Write that down. Haha. Ahem.
SANTI Do you have any hibiscus flowers?
LIEZEL I have certainly seen some before. I can search for some.
ANTIQUARIAN You’re quite forgetful for a youth.
SANTI I just like being sure of things, haha...
ANTIQUARIAN The conscientious type then! I can’t fault you for that. When I was your age-
SANTI (Time to go.)
SANTI Here they are! I can get that orchid sap out of these.
ANTIQUARIAN As I warned you, hibiscus flowers have all but gone extinct-
SANTI No worries about that, I uh, have my ways of getting some.
ANTIQUARIAN ...
SANTI So, that’s all we need, right?
ANTIQUARIAN Aren’t you still missing a babaylan to give this to? Hehehe.
SANTI ... Huh?
ANTIQUARIAN ... Nevermind. It was just a little joke.
ANTIQUARIAN The mixture should have a pH of 9.3 and salinity of 0.87.

ANTIQUARIAN Orchid sap will raise pH and lower salinity, while hibiscus sap will raise salinity and lower pH. Also, hibiscus petals can be used to neutralize the effects of both, giving you a fresh start.
ANTIQUARIAN Here, have this oil tube to gather the oil in. Just come back to me with it and I’ll tell you what pH and salinity level you got.
ANTIQUARIAN If I were you, I’d test out the levels of the base oil you’re working with first. In any case, that’s all you need to know. Off you go, now.

SANTI (There, I should bring this back to the Antiquarian to see if we got it right.)
ANTIQUARIAN You... you actually did it? How did- nevermind... I suppose your kind would have tricks up your sleeves...
SANTI Uh, what was that?
ANTIQUARIAN N-Nothing!
SANTI So, it’s good already?
ANTIQUARIAN Yes, haha! You have done quite a great job at this. Are you sure you are not being assisted by some kind of magical entity, hm? A mythical ghost perhaps?
LIEZEL ...
ANTIQUARIAN ...
SANTI ... No?
ANTIQUARIAN I see... Well, then! That is all you needed, how about I tell you how to get that bottle open?
ANTIQUARIAN Go on and dip that sealed bottle into the oil that you got this from. That should do the trick.
SANTI Here goes nothing…
SANTI It worked!
SANTI Thanks for the help, kuya.
ANTIQUARIAN Haha... right... of course. No problem.
ANTIQUARIAN Well then, I’ll get going! It’s getting late after all.
SANTI Oh, goodbye then!
ANTIQUARIAN (...)
ANTIQUARIAN (... Was that ore... Really what I thought it was...? I need to tell someone about this immediately!)
SANTI I managed to get the bottle open.
LIEZEL The bottle with the salakab, yes?
LIEZEL Excellent. You should be able to use its properties to uncover more.
SANTI (Maybe I can go back to-
LIEZEL Wait, Santi did you tell anybody about the sealed bottle to get it open?
SANTI Oh, yes?
SANTI Should I not have?
LIEZEL How did they react?
SANTI He was a little weird but he did get it open for me.
SANTI That’s just how most hobbyists are these days, though.
LIEZEL (I am not sure what he means, but considering Santi did not know about salakab and the taboo nature of magic in his time...
LIEZEL ... it is likely that nobody recognized the ore’s magical properties.)
LIEZEL Then, did you tell him that it is salakab?
SANTI No.
LIEZEL Alright then, no use worrying about it now.
SANTI (...??? Well I wasn’t worried before but I am now!)
SANTI (Okay, whatever. I should just hurry and go back to that place in the forest that gave me a weird feeling.)
SANTI These symbols... What could they mean?
LIEZEL Symbols that appear after approaching them with salakab... This could be quite the clue.
SANTI I’ll write them down for you. Are you going to investigate them?
LIEZEL I can certainly try.
LIEZEL (Hm... Perhaps I can give that manuscript at my home another look—there were definitely similar looking symbols written there.)
LIEZEL (... So far, all of our clues have been pointing at Servillano trying to tell someone something. That “someone” being my sister if I had to guess.)
LIEZEL (Is it possible that Ate Lorena leaving town... wasn’t a coincidence?)
SANTI The symbol that appeared lit up.
SANTI The symbol that appeared lit up.
SANTI The symbol that appeared lit up.
SANTI The symbol that appeared lit up.
SANTI The symbol that appeared lit up.
SANTI Whatever I managed to do, it didn’t work.
SANTI The symbol that appeared lit up.
SANTI The symbol that appeared lit up.
SANTI The symbol that appeared lit up.
SANTI The symbol that appeared lit up.
SANTI I feel like that was right!
LIEZEL Yes, it appears so.
LIEZEL (I should go back and reread the manuscript alongside the encoded messages. If magic was used to encode these messages, I should be able to translate them now.)
SANTI (I shouldn't head back to the town so soon.)
SANTI (I shouldn't head back to the town so soon.)
LIEZEL Either way, I could not have done any of this if not for my sister’s notes.
SANTI She sounds like a cool person.
LIEZEL She certainly is. It is quite a shame that she left town, otherwise she could help us crack this whole case wide open.
SANTI Where did she go?
LIEZEL ... Somewhere safe, I hope.
LIEZEL Anyways, these notes say quite a bit about salakab. It is a mystical ore that Giyalans have used as fuel for generations.
SANTI Why haven’t I heard of it before, then?
LIEZEL If I had to guess, the ore’s reputation must have been tarnished along with that of magic. It is quite a shame, really.
SANTI You said it can be used as fuel?
LIEZEL Indeed, it is but one of many of salakab’s uses. It is also often used in rituals or as a magical material...
LIEZEL Ah, but that is besides the point. What I am trying to say is that it may be able to solve your town’s current predicament.
LIEZEL ... If you can convince your people to make use of it.
LIEZEL However, you should not be too eager with its use. Its effects have not yet been fully researched and... hmm.
SANTI What is it?
LIEZEL Nothing, I was just distracted by these... strange symbols and phrases written in the manuscript. They do not appear to be notes, and I cannot make sense of them.
SANTI Oh! Do the symbols look anything like the encoded messages?
LIEZEL They... do. However, there does not appear to be a translation. It is possible that something here corresponds to a method of decoding...
LIEZEL But it certainly is not something I can decipher on my own.
LIEZEL Ha, it is possible Lorena even helped him come up with this. Still, that leaves us right back where we were.
LIEZEL Santi, could you look around your area? You may find something that could be of use to us. If you do, inform me right away.
SANTI I don’t know if there’s still anything else to find, but okay.
LIEZEL (In the meantime, I can read through this manuscript a bit longer.)
LIEZEL It's a series of strange phrases...
LIEZEL “Residing in a familiar abode is an unmoving still. A maiden to her dreams, bearing a vessel- browned by kiln.”
LIEZEL “Beneath the spot great distress once was, who flew now having learned of you.”
LIEZEL “A sharp and hardened steel blade well made. Its craftsmanship holds against the test of time.”
LIEZEL “Littered are the lies, read by the mass. Rewritten are their minds of magic.”
LIEZEL “Slice into the wailing eyes, its bark's no more than a silent cry.”
LIEZEL And, “Place the gem center of what you seek, a message then unraveled for you to read.”
LIEZEL What could they mean?
LIEZEL It's a series of strange phrases...
LIEZEL “Residing in a familiar abode is an unmoving still. A maiden to her dreams, bearing a vessel- browned by kiln.”
LIEZEL “Beneath the spot great distress once was, who flew now having learned of you.”
LIEZEL “A sharp and hardened steel blade well made. Its craftsmanship holds against the test of time.”
LIEZEL “Littered are the lies, read by the mass. Rewritten are their minds of magic.”
LIEZEL “Slice into the wailing eyes, its bark's no more than a silent cry.”
LIEZEL And, “Place the gem center of what you seek, a message then unraveled for you to read.”
LIEZEL What could they mean?
LIEZEL (A displaced patch of dirt… There seems to be something buried underneath.)
LIEZEL (Well, I still have the garden spade from before… I might be able to use it here.)
LIEZEL (What is this? Is this supposed to be a dagger? Its shape even resembles that of a snake...)
LIEZEL (This is definitely not a regular object—more so a weapon. Who ever thought about burying such a thing?)
LIEZEL (That woman… Was there a reason why she was directly on top of it?)
LIEZEL A dagger with a sturdy form and an interesting design. It would be a shame to dull a blade like this, especially if I’ll need it later.
LIEZEL There seems to be another symbol on this dagger, I’ll draw it for you, Santi.
SANTI Weird. Maybe it’s cursed for all we know...
LIEZEL Well, it is an abandoned possession.
SANTI Won’t the guards get suspicious if you’re carrying something dangerous like that?
LIEZEL Not if they do not notice it, no.
SANTI You’re really confident...
LIEZEL (I can stop carrying this spade around, too.)
LIEZEL (Should my comprehension not fail me, that phrase in the manuscript must lead me to acquiring something out of this tree. Although, I need to slice into its pitiful face…)
LIEZEL (I sure hope this tree is not cursed as I am not ready for a tree’s tantrum...)
LIEZEL Something is here.
LIEZEL (Hm. The gem fits perfectly within the curvature of the symbol.)
LIEZEL Huh—?!
LIEZEL (Some sort of magic was used to make this gem react to being placed within this tree. That gem… It might even be a piece of kulonium.)
LIEZEL (An oil spill. Workers have been throwing their excess oil in the forest for some reason.)
LIEZEL (An oil spill?)
LIEZEL While I could not find any bottled oil, I do remember that there were some workers who have been throwing oil in the forest in the past month.
LIEZEL We may be able to acquire some oil from that area. I’ll map it out for you.
SANTI Good to know. I thought we’d be locked out of this one thing that could open this bottle.
SANTI (I can find where that oil was in my time. With any luck, there might be some left.)
LIEZEL (These flowers might be what Santi is searching for.)
LIEZEL I found some flowers. Hibiscus flowers, to be specific.
SANTI Oh! That’s good, I think. We just need some of it, not the whole flower.
SANTI You might have to extract some of its contents though.
LIEZEL No problem.
LIEZEL Hmm... This should rebalance the pH and salinity.
LIEZEL This lowers the pH and raises the salinity of the oil.
LIEZEL This lowers the pH and raises the salinity of the oil.
LIEZEL This lowers the pH and raises the salinity of the oil.
LIEZEL This lowers the pH and raises the salinity of the oil.
LIEZEL This lowers the pH and raises the salinity of the oil.
LIEZEL This lowers the pH and raises the salinity of the oil.
LIEZEL (I could try speaking with the guards at the outpost again.)
LIEZEL (If my hunch is right, I could be able to learn more about the more bureaucratic affairs of the Disidensiya.)
LIEZEL (... With enough nagging, that is.)
LIEZEL Ah, I won't need these items I got from the hibiscus anymore.
LIEZEL “Giyala falls by his betrayal...” (Why would Servillano write this?)
SANTI Betrayal? Who did that?
LIEZEL I fear I do not have an answer for you either, Santi.
LIEZEL We have to find out where this leads us, it is most likely a cause for concern. We must be swift.
SANTI The only betrayal I can think of is the people’s trust with kulonium... but it does say ‘his’.
LIEZEL Yes. What we know is that this is referring to a person. For him to say it was a betrayal must mean it was someone he knew well...
SANTI What if it was one of his coworkers? Friends? Oh… What if it’s you...
LIEZEL Nonsense. I have no reason nor any motivation to betray someone like Servillano. He is my sister’s husband even.
SANTI If it’s not you and it’s not your sister... Then, who? Is there anyone close to him aside from you guys?
LIEZEL As much as I do not want to think about the possibilities, I may have someone in mind.
LIEZEL If this was written by Servillano as we figured out, he used symbols that only he and my sister know of. These messages must have been written for her.
SANTI If it’s still here though, she probably never found them.
LIEZEL (Did she leave before these were created by Servillano? Or did she... These thoughts worry me.)
LIEZEL That is a possibility. These may have happened all at once without anyone’s notice.
LIEZEL With the Disidensya in conflict as stated by rumors, they might actually hold some truth in them like I feared...
LIEZEL (Hm? There is a commotion outside.)
MADAM GUARD Attention, attention!
MADAM GUARD Another magic attack has happened near the east of town! All townsfolk are advised to stay away!
LIEZEL !?
LIEZEL (Another magic attack!)
LIEZEL (This could be our chance to get another lead. I should follow them and see if I can investigate the area.)

data.guideTextData: Everything is falling into place, but there is still work to be done. Crack the code!
